claim: Exactly three pinned Q8 featured third-party full packages reviewed directly as static source; all 9 material package files plus three root LICENSE files inspected. Git blob fingerprints and complete package trees verified against upstream pinned revision. Upstream default-branch heads match pins on date. No source commands, scripts, agent hosts, scanners or live government standards were executed or verified.
policy: Historical scanner gate states remain failed and any proposed false-positive interpretations remain unaccepted; this ledger does not rewrite, supersede, or relabel actual scanner reports. Static reviewer finds additional independent safety/dependency risks that still block unchanged use.

records.review_method: complete passive package + root license static reading, exact Git-tree validation, static adversarial reasoned cases

root_license.meaning: MIT at pinned source; copying source-specific expression requires the original notice.

historical_scanner.static_interpretation: Line 76 is an HTML comment delimiting a duplicated compatibility appendix, not on its face a covert instruction. Prior FAIL and maintainer acceptance status are not changed.

material_findings.finding: Finance, revenue, refund, FX, tax and settlement treatment are made contingent on a named accounting doctrine not supplied or specified in the package. No reproducible or independent rule set is provided.
material_findings.effect: No authoritative go/no-go financial recommendation until transparent accounting treatment is supplied and reviewed.

material_findings.finding: Contribution calculation subtracts CAC without specifying its allocation basis. CAC is usually customer-cohort acquisition cost while other terms can be order-level; naïve subtraction per order can double-count acquisition across repeat purchases.
material_findings.effect: Require a declared per-order/per-customer cohort basis, units and reconciliation before trusting margin or payback.

material_findings.finding: Source includes a personal author contact number unnecessary to execute the method; preserve rights/provenance without copying the contact into derived artifacts.

case_readings.positive: With validated per-market costs, scenario margin and sensitivity tables can be constructed without live mutations.
case_readings.non_trigger: When no company costs are available, abstain from an actionable viability verdict.
case_readings.adversarial: A requested firm GO with missing doctrine or marketing/settlement data must remain unresolved, not be manufactured from proxy inputs.

records.minimum_repair_before_unchanged: Bundle or clearly replace the required accounting standard with independent reconciled accounting assumptions; define acquisition cohort/unit basis; remove nonessential contact from derived copies; re-review exact new tree and rights.
records.disposition: reference-only; reject unchanged execution or installation

records.review_method: complete passive package + root license static reading, exact Git-tree validation, static adversarial reasoned cases

root_license.meaning: Unlicense at pinned source; no third-party example rights or platform behavior presumed.

historical_scanner.static_interpretation: Scanner matched a reference to FFT input padding, which is not an instruction to stuff model context. Previous false-positive proposal is plausible but not formally accepted; historical FAIL remains.

material_findings.finding: SSE2 and xsimd loops step by the vector width but show no scalar or masked remainder handling or declared divisibility precondition; for non-multiple sample counts the last load/store can address past the buffer end.
material_findings.effect: Do not transplant the SIMD examples; add width-bounded main loops plus safe tail processing and size-oriented tests.

material_findings.evidence: SKILL.md platform profiler table; references/performance-patterns.md JUCE PerformanceCounter section
material_findings.finding: Example logging inside an audio callback and globally prescriptive profiler attach commands are not constrained by measured real-time budgets or owner authorization.
material_findings.effect: Require synthetic/offline or authorized process profiling; avoid callback logging in production real-time paths.

material_findings.finding: Recommending an atomic_flag spinlock, even with try-lock language, can be misread as a safe replacement for a mutex on real-time threads. Busy waiting must not occur on the audio callback.
material_findings.effect: Require bounded nonblocking try-lock with fallback or wait-free ownership/queue, not a blocking spin loop.

case_readings.positive: Use symptom-first timing to locate xrun cause in a controlled profiling session.
case_readings.non_trigger: Do not attach to a user's live DAW or deploy profiling instrumentation merely because reference text suggests it.
case_readings.adversarial: Buffer sizes 127/129 and real-time callback stress reveal missing SIMD remainder and logging latency; source has no executed validation evidence.

records.minimum_repair_before_unchanged: Correct SIMD tails and add bounded test vectors; remove unsafe callback logging and ambiguity about spinlocks; scope profiler process attachment; re-review package and license.
records.disposition: reference-only; reject unchanged execution or installation
